paite: Huan Ephraimte'n akiang ah, a hon "Bangziak a hichibang bawl e, Midiante na douna ua na hon chial sam louh?" achi uhi. Huchi in nakpitak in amah atai uhi.
heading: Midiante Zohna Nanung

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Nou toh genkak ding ke'n bang ka hihzou a eita? Abiezerte grep loh sang a Ephraimte grep loh hoihzaw hilou maw?
Pathian in Midiante kumpipa Oreb leh Zeeb na khut uah ahon peta hi. Huchi in nou toh genkak ding in ke'n bang ka hihzou a eita?" achi hi. Huchi in huai thu agentak in atung a ahehna uh adaita hi.
Gideon leh akiang a om mi zathumte'n Jordan lui aphasuk ua, akan ua, bah mah le uh adelh teitei uhi.
Sukoth a mite kiang ah, "Hehpih in kei hon zuite sangpek pe dih ua; abah mahmahta uh. Midiante kumpipa Zebah leh Zalmunna delh ka hi,” achi hi.
Sukoth a miliante'n, “Zebah leh Zalmunna na khut a om khinta uhia, huchi a na sepaihte tanghou ka piak pah mai ding uh?" achi uh.
Gideon in hiai ziak in, "TOUPA'N Zebah leh Zalmunna ka khut a ahon piak chiang in gamdai a ling leh louling neite in na sa uh ka kuikek ding," achi hi.
Huai a pan Penuel ah ahohtou ua, akiang uah huchi mah bang in agen nawn hi. Penuel a mite'n Sukoth a mite dawn mah bang in adawng uhi.
Penuel khomite kiang ah, "Vualzou a ka hong kik nawn chiang in, hiai kulh ka hihchim ding," achi hi.
Zebah leh Zalmunna bel Karkor ah a-om ua, asepaihte leh suahlam mite sepaih asibang teng, singkhat-le-sangnga toh; namsau dok mi nuaikhat-le-singnih lah asi khinta ngal ua.
Gideon bel Nob leh Jogbeh suahlam a puanin a tengte lampi ah ahohtou a, sepaihte ava dou a; sepaihte galmuangtak in ana om ngal uhi.
Zebah leh Zalmunna ataikekta ua; amau adelh ua; huchi in Midiante kumpipa nih Zebah leh Zalmunna aman ua, sepaihte tengteng apatausakgawp uhi.
Joash tapa Gideon bel kidouna a pan nisuah ma in ahong kik nawnta hi.
Sukoth ah tangval khat aman ua, thu adong ua; huchi in Sukoth a miliante leh upate min agelhsak vek a, sawmsagih-le-sagih ahi uh.
Sukoth a mite kiang ah ahohtou a, "Zebah leh Zalmunna en dih ve ua, hiaite akei ua, Zebah leh Zalmunna na khut ua omsa bang a, mibahte tanghou ka piak ding uh, chi a na hon enghou uh?" achi hi.
Huchi in huai khua upate aman a, gamdai ling leh louling neite in Sukoth mite athuhilh hi.
Penuel khokulh ahihchim a, khua a mite leng athat hi.
Huchi in Zebah leh Zalmunna kiang ah, "Tabor tang a na mithahte uh mi bangchibang ahi ua? achi hi. Amau, Nangmah bang ahi uh; Kumpipa tapate abang chiat uh,” achi uhi.
Ama'n, "Ka unaute ahi uh, ka nu tapate mahmah ahi ve ua. TOUPA ahin bang in, amaute na hinghawi le uchin zaw, nou hon that lou mah ding hi veng in," achi hi.
Atapa upapen Jether kiang ah, "Khai le, nang amaute that in," achi hi. Himahleh tangval in anamsau aphawi kei; tangval lel ahih lai ziak in alau hi.

Huchi in Zebah leh Zalmunna in, "Nangmah hong kisa in, hong satlum tanla. Piching leh piching kisual ding ahi," achi uhi. Huchi in Gideon athou a, Zebah leh Zalmunna that in, sangawngsaute ngawng zepnate ala hi.
Huchi in Israel mite'n Gideon kiang ah, "Nang ka tung uah vaihawm in, nang leh na tapa leh na tapa tapate tan in leng; nang Midiante a pan lah na hon hunkheta ngal a," achi uhi.
Gideon in akiang uah, "Ke'n zaw na tung uah vai ka hawm kei ding. Ka tapa in leng na tung uah vai ahawm sam kei ding. TOUPA'N na tung uah vai ahawm zaw ding," achi hi.
Gideon in akiang uah, "Thil khat ahihleh hon nget ka ut, michih in na gallak bilbah uh hon pe chiat un," achi hi. (Ishmaelte ahih ziak un dangka-eng bilbah anei uhi).
Amau, "Phaltak in ka hon pe ding uh," achi uhi. Huchi in puan aphah ua, michih in agallak bilbah uh apaikhe chiat uhi.
Huai dangka-eng bilbah angette gikdan dangka-eng shekel sangkhat-le-zasagih ahi; hakkolte, bilbahte, Midian kumpipate puan sandup sim louh in, asangawngsaute uh khainiang omte leng tel lou in.
Gideon in huaite in Ephod abawl a, a-omna Ophrah ah akoih hi. Israel tengteng in hiai thil ah ang a kawm uh. Huchi in Gideon leh a-inkote a ding in thang ahong hita hi.
Huchi in Midiante bel Israel suante nuaisiah in a-om ua; atangkhe zou nawn kei uhi. Huchi in Gideon damsung kum sawmli sung in gam galmuang in a-omta hi.
Joash tapa Jerubbaal apai a, a-inn ah atengta hi.
heading: Gideon Sihna

paite: Gideon in zi tampi aneih ziak in ama suan mahmah tapa sawmsagih anei hi.
Shekem a amei in tapa asuansak lai a, amin Abimelek asa hi.
Joash tapa Gideon kha leh khuk tuah a dam in asita a, Abiezer mi Ophrah a apa Joash han ah avui uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Gideon asih phet in Israel suante akinunghei ua, Baalte toh ang a kawm ua, pathian in Baal-berith aneita uhi.
Israel suante'n akim ua melmate tengteng lak a pan amau hunkhepa TOUPA a Pathian uh atheigige kei uhi.
Jerubbaal, Gideon kichi mah, Israelte tung a theihtawp a hoih suahpa inkote leng ahehpih kei uhi.
